record.title: AI Safety Governance Framework 2.0
record.original_title: 人工智能安全治理框架2.0
record.issuing_body: National Cybersecurity Standardization Technical Committee (TC260) and National Computer Network Emergency Response Technical Team/Coordination Center of China (CNCERT/CC), under the guidance of the Cyberspace Administration of China

english_version.by: National Technical Committee 260 on Cybersecurity of SAC (TC260) and CNCERT/CC

record.summary: Version 2.0 of China's AI safety governance framework, a TC260 technical document. It updates the 2024 risk classification into inherent risks of AI technology, application risks and derivative risks from AI application, up to catastrophic risk, and sets principles for grading AI safety risks into five levels by application scenario, intelligence level and application scale. It proposes technical countermeasures and 14 governance measures, including registration of AI systems in critical information infrastructure, traceable management of AI-generated content, an AI safety evaluation system and testing for loss-of-control risk, plus safety guidelines and principles for trustworthy AI.
record.notes: Released on 15 Sept 2025 at the main forum of the 2025 National Cybersecurity Publicity Week and issued as a TC260 technical document; the cover is dated September 2025 and names TC260 and CNCERT/CC. The CAC release notice says CNCERT led the drafting under CAC guidance, while the framework's preface says TC260 organised CNCERT/CC, research institutes and companies to draft it under CAC guidance. The framework is published as a single document with the Chinese text followed by an English text. Its annexes set the risk-grading principles, basic principles for trustworthy AI (beginning with final human control) and terminology. Succeeded by version 3.0, issued by TC260 on 14 Sept 2026, which updates the risk classification and the technical and comprehensive governance measures.

verification.note: Stored and read: the CAC release notice of 15 Sept 2025 (cac.gov.cn), the 92-page framework PDF linked from it (cac.gov.cn; Chinese text followed by the issuers' English text), and the CAC notice of 14 Sept 2026 on version 3.0. The notice and the PDF confirm the title, date, issuing bodies and content; the English title and the English text come from the PDF itself, which carries no translation label. The PDF's Chinese text layer uses CJK radical code points for some characters, so some quotes look unusual. The secondary URL (tc260.org.cn) stores the TC260 home page, not the framework's posting. The status rests on the release of version 3.0 by the same committee; the 3.0 notice does not say in words that version 2.0 is withdrawn.

judgment.status_reasoning: The latest event in the stored files is the release of version 3.0 of the same framework by TC260 on 14 Sept 2026 (CAC notice), which lists 1.0 and 2.0 as its predecessors and updates their risk classification and measures. Version 2.0 is therefore Superseded, as the record already says.
judgment.scope_reasoning: A government-sponsored AI safety and risk-governance framework by China's national cybersecurity standards committee; clearly in scope, no scope_note.
